biotools.summary: CycleVI is a deep generative model that disentangles cell cycle-driven variation from other signals in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data using a dedicated circular latent subspace. It provides a principled framework for analyzing cellular heterogeneity while accurately inferring continuous cell cycle phase.
biotools.name: CycleVI
